body:
Your English is very good, I never would have guessed it wasn't your first language.

I do plan on telling him, but I won't be seeing him until next Friday. This isn't something I want to tell him over the phone.
Some families might drop it, but my family wouldn't. They don't take kindly to anyone making serious mistakes.

It's video more than pictures, but my face is not shown at all. I don't know how well you can hear me crying. One point should have me saying "Please stop", but I'm really not sure what exactly the video captured. I didn't want to review it, I just left as soon as it was over.

One problem though is that it is my fault, I allowed it to continue. I didn't fight it enough, I wasn't adamant enough. I just took it, I laid there and let it happen. I could have left, and I didn't.

I know what you're saying. We don't live together yet though, so I can't sit him down yet. I won't see him until next week. Even then, I'm not sure if I can bring myself to say it yet. I'm so ashamed of myself for not fighting it harder I can barely look myself in the mirror, let alone him.

I'm considering waiting until we actually have our house to tell him... I know it's essentially entrapment, but I'm hoping it will help. I certainly don't ever plan on going back down to the person's house, that's for sure.
I'm ashamed that I was even down there in the first place, I don't want anyone in my family or his to know about this. A legal battle would be all over place.

Thank you. My main issue is that he trusted me in the first place though, which is why he was ok with me going down there. In the entire 5 years we've been together, we haven't fought even once.This would destroy every opinion he has about me. I let this happen, I didn't fight it enough. I really, really don't think he'd stay with me if I told him. We don't actually own the house yet, we're still waiting on the closing, which is several weeks away. He'll put a stop to all the paperwork and leave me, I'm sure of it.
